name: Password Pusher v2
tagline: Give your users the tools to be secure by default.
description: Password Pusher is an open source application to communicate passwords over the web. Links to passwords expire after a certain number of views and/or time has passed.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Postgres password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-pwpush-v2 application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-pwpush-v2
  # The `big-bear-pwpush-v2` service definition
  big-bear-pwpush-v2:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-pwpush-v2
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: pglombardo/pwpush:2.16.1@sha256:d24ecfacc4d902422ed828530cc370d18b750c391beddf790ebb0a67621ea8bd
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Environment variables for the container
    environment:
      # PostgreSQL database connection string (v2 dropped MySQL/MariaDB support)
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://pwpusher:${SECRET_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@big-bear-pwpush-v2-db:5432/passwordpusher_db
      # Password expiration settings
      PWP__PW__EXPIRE_AFTER_DAYS_DEFAULT: "1"
      PWP__PW__EXPIRE_AFTER_VIEWS_MIN: "1"
      PWP__PW__RETRIEVAL_STEP_DEFAULT: "true"
      # v2.0: Replaces `enable_logins`; allow anonymous pushes and control signup/login
      # PWP__ALLOW_ANONYMOUS: "true"
      # PWP__DISABLE_SIGNUPS: "false"
      # PWP__DISABLE_LOGINS: "false"
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      # Storage volume
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/storage:/opt/PasswordPusher/storage:rw
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      # Mapping port 5101 of the host to port 5100 of the container (different from v1's 5100)
      - "${APP_PORT}:5100"
    networks:
      - big_bear_pwpush_v2_network
    depends_on:
      big-bear-pwpush-v2-db:
        condition: service_healthy
  big-bear-pwpush-v2-db:
    container_name: big-bear-pwpush-v2-db
    # PostgreSQL required for v2 (MySQL/MariaDB no longer supported)
    image: postgres:16-alpine@sha256:57c72fd2a128e416c7fcc499958864df5301e940bca0a56f58fddf30ffc07777
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: "pwpusher"
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: "passwordpusher_db"
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U pwpusher -d passwordpusher_db"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    networks:
      - big_bear_pwpush_v2_network
networks:
  big_bear_pwpush_v2_network:
    driver: bridge
